svg.title: C4: Global Dynamic Spatiotemporal Prediction Mixture of Experts
svg.desc: Exact current C4: parallel original spatial and switching-latent temporal encoders; four shared experts; one shared forecast head; sample-dependent, horizon-shared router; prediction-level mixture. Original four-horizon Huber and Switch KL.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: C4 | Global Dynamic Spatiotemporal Prediction MoE

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One sample-conditioned router · four shared experts · prediction-level fusion · four cumulative-return horizons
